name: ELIX Clock
description: Native World Clock, Alarm, Countdown Timer, and Stopwatch suite for ELIX OS

set_alarm.name: set_alarm
set_alarm.description: Schedule an alarm with a specific 24h time, custom label, and optional active repeat days.

time.description: Alarm trigger time in 24h format (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS), e.g. '07:30' or '23:59'

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the alarm

repeatDays.description: Days on which to repeat the alarm (e.g. ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'])

start_timer.name: start_timer
start_timer.description: Start a countdown timer with a specified duration in seconds and label.

label.description: Optional label or description for the countdown timer

get_world_time.name: get_world_time
get_world_time.description: Retrieve the current local and formatted time for a given IANA timezone.
